methods_quotes.q: The national baseline is the mean percentage of visits for ILI during noninfluenza weeks for the previous three seasons plus two standard deviations.
The epidemic threshold is set at 1.645 standard deviations above the seasonal baseline.
The national percentage of patient visits for ILI is weighted on the basis of state population.
